command.message: User clarification: paper reading may be used to resolve uncertainties or validate facts. For subsequent discretionary literature work, state which candidate or route, fact or uncertainty, and possible judgment the source could inform. A source can be relevant without being important to read now. Prioritize exact identity, substrate scope, mechanistic support, assay conditions and controls, including checks of claims already accepted. A useful result may support, contradict or leave a claim unresolved; do not favor positive results or invent missing evidence. Retain relevant background for later and prefer focused source inspection when it can answer the question. Continue bounded exploration of distinct plausible routes when justified.
